main_text.l: קָלַל Levari, Levem. Vetocem esse; Vilescere, Vilem esse vel haberi. Niphal נִקַּל Levem, Vilem se reputare, Abjicere, Leviculū, Levem fieri aut haberi. Pihel קִלֵּל Maledicere, Blasphemare, Exsecrari: Geminatā primā radicali קַלְקֵל Levigare, Tergere. Expolire. Pyhal קֻלַּל Maledici. Hiphil הִקְלִיל Levare, Allevare, Elevare: Leve, Vile reddere, Vilipendere. Hithpahel הִתְקַלְקֵל Levare, Leviter movere se.
קִיֵּם Pihel Ludificare, Eludere. Hithpahel הִתְקַיֵּם Illudere.
קָלַע Sculpere, Incidere. Pihel קִלַּע Funda mittere vel projicere.
קַלַּע m. Funda: plur. קַלָּעִים, Funda: item Tapetes ocellati, variis figuris quasi Incisi: item Valva, sic dicta quia incisa per medium.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel pointing is copied from the scan and may contain small errors. Doubtful Hebrew forms in the Pihel and Hithpahel entries are not certain.
